description: This file defines the MultiRegionClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, which manages multiple regional clients and handles region partitioning and client pooling for AWS services.

classes.name: MultiRegionClient
classes.description: A client that manages multiple regional AWS service clients, supports region and partition configuration, and handles command creation and execution.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns configuration arguments related to client factory and partition settings with default values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the MultiRegionClient with specified configuration options, setting up handler lists, client pool, and region partitioning.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the default region the client is configured to communicate with.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates a new command object for a specified operation name with given arguments.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration options, either all or a specific one.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Returns the credentials used by the underlying client.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the handler list used for command processing.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Returns the API description of the service.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint URL the client is configured to use.

methods.name: useCustomHandler
methods.description: Sets a custom handler for command execution.

methods.name: isUseCustomHandler
methods.description: Checks if a custom handler has been set.

methods.name: getClientFromPool
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a regional client from the pool based on the specified region.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Derives the service name from the class name for client resolution.

methods.name: getRegionFromArgs
methods.description: Determines the region from command arguments or default configuration.
